Questionnaire using minValue and maxValue extensions

Age must be 0–120 (inclusive).

title: minValue / maxValue
description: A single integer question constrained with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/minValue and http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/maxValue. The allowed answer is 0 through 120 inclusive. Instance validation checks the extensions are well-formed; it does not check that a later QuestionnaireResponse sits in that range.
